item.title: Attestor is no longer memory for your coding assistant
item.description: The editor vendors shipped memory for free. The benchmark race became a race about which LLM answers the question. And every serious conversation was about something else entirely: when many agents share one memory, who is allowed to write, who is allowed to forget, and can you prove it afterwards. So that is what Attestor is now: governed memory for multi-agent production meshes. What that means in the code, not the deck.
